title: Don Carter's Kirtland interdisciplinary groups with Kissinger
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Don Carter's Kirtland interdisciplinary groups with Kissinger, about 1962 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: This guy Don Carter uh who was head of advanced research at Kirtland Air Force Base uh in 1962 is convening these interdisciplinary groups

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in 1962 a man named Don Carter, head of advanced research at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, was bringing together groups of experts from many different fields. He says Henry Kissinger, who later became a top American diplomat, was involved with these groups. Michels tells it as a sign that serious, high-level thinking about unusual matters was going on near the nation's nuclear labs at the time.
